'''Y66 Division''' was a ground assault unit in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
'''Y66 Division''' included [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|''Persuader''-class tank droids]], [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]], and [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droids]] in its arsenal. All units in the division were given enhanced self-aware programming in order to improve their efficiency in combat.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the division's [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and tri-droids provided a second wave of attack against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], while tank droids were used as recon scouts. Tri-droids served as mobile heavy artillery, keeping the Republic's forces from advancing. [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and a small squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in a flanking maneuver against Y66 Division, successfully destroying the tri-droids and leaving the troops led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to mop up the battle droids.
